data.summary: Uriel is a Warframe that focuses on supporting his demons in combat through various passive abilities. He has moderate damage output from Brimstone and decent crowd control with snaring and latching effects. However, Uriel's survivability is low due to his lack of defensive capabilities, and he does not have any stealth or complex abilities.
